name: Oracle Pale Rider (Duskwalker Oracle)
body:
An agent of Death himself, a pale rider gallops through the world like a shadow, granting the gift of repose to those whose time has come- and without leaving a lasting impression on anyone she meets.

Oracle’s Curse: A pale rider must choose the haunted, powerless prophecy, pranked, or reclusive curse at 1st level.

Bonus Spells

These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels: memory lapse (2nd), invisibility (4th), phantom steed (8th), fleeting memory (10th), ethereal jaunt (14th), mass fleeting memory (16th).

Revelations

A pale rider must take the following revelations at the listed levels.

Flicker (Sp)

As the whimsy mystery revelation. You must take this revelation at 1st level.

Forgotten Presence (Sp)

As the intrigue mystery revelation. You must take this revelation at 7th level.

Spirit Walk (Sp)

As the bones mystery revelation. You must take this revelation at 11th level.

Recommended Mysteries: ancestor, bones, intrigue, occult, reaper, time.
